game_title: Elif Ladder – Net Menders' Pier Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about threat_level to power up the deckhand and open the harbor gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
